method: Built-in imagegen; complete missing chapter card reconstruction from native story references

prompts.zh-CN:
Create a complete game UI sprite sheet for the missing KartRider story chapter xyy_1. Use the supplied original game sprites as faithful character references: Pleasant Goat smiling, Dao disguised as a sheep smiling, gray wolf in patched orange cap. Use native Green Grassland scene reference for green meadow/trees/background, and supplied original chapter card only as the layout/style reference. New artwork should closely match classic 2D flat cartoon line art and cheerful bright 2000s KartRider story menu. On each card, compose Dao and Pleasant Goat on the left 48%, wolf may peek from behind small in the far left/background; soft green grassland extends across, fading into a pale neutral luminous area on right for lettering. Right half has bold playful white/dark-outlined title, smaller blue subtitle, all baked in as coherent complete illustration, no pasted opaque label/patch. Do NOT copy unrelated title or original red-haired characters from layout reference.

Output ONE opaque 2x2 atlas, four identical composition frames with exact equal cell sizes and no gutters, no outside margins or captions. Overall aspect ratio 1088:536. Each cell aspect ratio 272:134. Top-left NORMAL, top-right HOVER (same illustration slightly brighter with subtle blue edge), bottom-left PRESSED (same illustration slightly darker), bottom-right DISABLED (same illustration entirely grayscale including all text). Thin dark 1px at native resolution card border. Keep all art and letters inside its cell with at least 5px native margin. NO overlapping cells or any text other than requested title and subtitle. The four states must match the same scene/characters/letter positions; only light/color state changes. Make the letters crisp and readable when each card is downscaled to 272x134.
Language zh-CN. Exact title, with suggested line breaks represented by \n: "皮蛋的\n青青草原之旅！". Exact small subtitle: "剧情". Render these words identically in all four states. No other language or other lettering.
